newsitem.title: USA: Adaptec up on bullish outlook. [CORRECTED 21:42 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Adaptec up on bullish outlook. [CORRECTED 21:42 GMT]

text.p: Shares of Adaptec Inc rallied Wednesday amid an improving outlook about the company's results for the second half of the fiscal year, analysts said.
(Corrects to remove all reference to Bear Stearns research report).
Adaptec gained 1-12/16 to 32-9/16 with about 4.9 million shares traded in mid-afternoon, more than twice its daily trading volume.
Adaptec makes computer subsystems, software and chips that accelerate the movement of data.
Analysts said they expect Adaptec's results to show increasing strength during the second half of the current fiscal year, which ends in March 1998.
"The first half is always more modest," said John Rossi, an analyst with Robertson Stephens.
